name: Sengoku Great People screen: 75 individuals, zero musicians; open and refresh without any Lua/UI error

steps.code:
if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end
local class=GameInfo.GreatPersonClasses['GREAT_PERSON_CLASS_MUSICIAN']
if not class then error('musician class missing') end
local count,total=0,0
for row in GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals() do
 total=total+1
 if row.GreatPersonClassType=='GREAT_PERSON_CLASS_MUSICIAN' then count=count+1 end
end
if count~=0 or total~=75 then error('expected 0 musicians and 75 remaining great people, got '..count..'/'..total) end
JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_OPENED=0
JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_HANDLER=function() JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_OPENED=JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_OPENED+1 end
LuaEvents.GreatPeople_OpenGreatPeople.Add(JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_HANDLER)
LuaEvents.LaunchBar_OpenGreatPeoplePopup()
return 'musicians=0 greatPeople=75; requested Great People screen'

if ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('Great People screen did not open') end
RefreshCurrentGreatPeople()
RefreshPreviousGreatPeople()
RefreshCurrentGreatPeople()
if ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('Great People screen closed during refresh') end
print('[JAC_GREAT_PEOPLE_ZERO_MUSICIANS] opened and refreshed current/history/current')
return true

Close()
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('Great People screen did not close') end
return true

if JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_OPENED~=1 then error('Great People open event count '..tostring(JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_OPENED)) end
LuaEvents.GreatPeople_OpenGreatPeople.Remove(JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_HANDLER)
JAC_AUTOTEST_GP_HANDLER=nil
return 'Great People screen opened once with zero musicians'
